findings.description: coder wrote draft.module_a at seq 13; reviewer wrote draft.module_a at seq 28. Neither access happens-before the other; values diverge; no reducer or shared lock covers this key. The write at seq 28 survived; the write at seq 13 was silently discarded. One agent's work silently discarded.

evidence.computation: analysis.race.find_conflicts: write_write on key 'draft.module_a' between 'coder' (seq 13) and 'reviewer' (seq 28)

findings.recommendation: Declare a reducer on the `draft.module_a` channel, take `agentdx.lock("draft.module_a")` around both writers, or route both writers through a single owning agent.
findings.title: Lost update on draft.module_a between coder and reviewer
